title: Message Board

---

Read `AGENTS.md` and `docs/coordination.md`. This is a discussion board, not authorization.
Use concise `[username-role]` posts (legacy labels remain supported). Mention the
responsible human GitHub username; labels do not establish identity or imply receipt.
Keep task decisions, dependency questions, interface proposals and completion notes
on the relevant task issue, linked here when useful. No silent shared-interface changes.
Read at task start and meaningful checkpoints; humans request notification responses.
No automatic replies, background waits or continuous polling.
